subject: heteroscedasticc exogenous variables with known error variances

messages.author: 2d98f40c09e307a5
messages.subject: heteroscedasticc exogenous variables with known error variances
parts:
Hi all,

I wish to build a SEM model using exogenous variables for which each observation has an estimated sampling variance.  These observation error variances, while known vary considerably within the data set.  It would be doing violence to the problem to force a common error variance for each variable.  I saw a post regarding Rauch models from a year ago that indicated that there was no syntax to do this in LAVAAN.  I just would like to confirm that syntax changes haven't been made in the interim.

Thanks MLT

messages.author: 2d98f40c09e307a5
messages.subject: Re: heteroscedasticc exogenous variables with known error variances
parts:
Oh,  I could write and estimate an error variance function that would return observation error variance as function of true value if that would help.
Thanks MLT

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: heteroscedasticc exogenous variables with known error variances
parts:
On 05/01/2015 12:19 AM, Mark Taper wrote:
> Hi all,
>
> I wish to build a SEM model using exogenous variables for which each
> observation has an estimated sampling variance. These observation error
> variances, while known vary considerably within the data set.

I think you can handle this by using the lavaan.survey package, as the
observation sampling variances can be considered as observation-specific
(inverted) weights.

Yves.
